stem: Child comes to you (GP) with a vesicular rash that have some crusted lesions. It is itchy and red. Regarding the above:

options.text: It is infectious 10-21 days prior to the rash
Infectious 2 days before rash till all lesions have crusted over
Infectious from 2 days before till the rash begins to crust
Infectious from 2 days before till 21 days after
